name: audit-a-missing-exon-is-read-from-the-introns
turns: Check the introns of PcyM_0736700 in P. cynomolgi M against the RNA-seq junctions the site serves. Is its gene model right?
rationale: A positive of the answer key, asked as an intron support question: the model lacks an exon the RNA-seq junctions support. The audit keeps the error and names the missing exon as its cause.
